name: Geometric Vector Isomorphism
description: Replaces the scalar boolean condition ("sum of deviations < 2") with an equivalent 3D vector sum $\vec{F} = \vec{u}_1 + \vec{u}_2 + (2, 2, 2) \neq (0, 0, 0)$. By mapping the boolean states to vectors $(1, 1, 1)$ and $(-1, -1, -1)$, the problem superficially resembles a continuous geometric or physics simulation. This prevents models from immediately triggering their 2-SAT pattern matching, forcing them to first algebraically reduce the vector equation back into boolean logic.
